title: Freezing
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In 2065 Earth is at war with extra-dimensional aliens called Nova, fought by genetically engineered young women called Pandoras and their male partners, Limiters. Kazuya Aoi, whose Pandora sister died, enrolls at West Genetics Academy and befriends Satellizer el Bridget, a feared fighter who cannot bear to be touched. The story widens into experiments on girls, corporate secrets and Kazuya's family links to the Nova.
life_message: Loyalty and love between partners can overcome trauma and an inhuman war.
